issue.title: fix(es/transforms/compat/es2015): fix for-of variable scope in generator
issue.body:
Fixes https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/2624

I found that by reordering `block_scoping` and `regenerator` passes in `es2015` compat, it would mitigate the scoping issue since this enables for `"_loop"` temporary function to be correctly introduced for the body of `for_of` pass.
I'm not too sure if this doesn't bring any regression but I thought this could be a reasonable idea to try, so here is my first PR.
I would appreciate any feedback and thanks a lot for the review!
